lines.text: You're red on the sitrep. Doesn't reach down here. Nothing reaches down here. That's the good news and the other news. //99
Reyes's. Ha. Tell him the ledger drop was me. He knows. He wants to hear it again. //99
The record's back, kid. Read the original. A familiar voice isn't a signature. //99
Your release log names the accepted mission credential. It proves that door opened for that work. It does not grant the whole installation. //99
One word later, kid. That's what your record says. I'm asking for no more copies. A changed recording still gets to be heard. //99
The second fragment repeats the same unfinished words. You retain its sealed copy. Resemblance does not prove continuity. //99
Four willing templates reach shelter in your record. The rig reports masked tags. They receive no clinic evaluation. Keep both costs in view. //99
You mapped five cells and the unlisted entrance. Strand says it is missing from the public chart. Keep both versions. //99
Oh, a live one. Kid, you have no idea how quiet it gets in here between visitors. Twenty-four years. I've counted the ticks. //99
Fresh decant. I was born, actually, or the guy I'm a copy of was. Neither of us remembers it. We've got that in common. //99
Kid. Still live? Good. I keep counting the ticks between visitors. Bad habit for a recording. //99

barks.text: Went down with a rig I built from shaft salvage. Great rig. Best I ever... best I ever... best I ever. Sorry. That's where it always goes. //99
